verdict.rationale: Undermind's MCP tooling reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers questions across many papers at once, a real multi-item operation, and an enterprise API supports programmatic queries that could be scripted at scale. General bulk management actions (curating into folders, starring, editing notes) are described only per item, and none of this is independently corroborated. missing for 10: documented bulk curate/star/tag/delete across many papers, batch API or OpenAPI spec (probes 404), hands-on corroboration of multi-item operations.
